crossRefs.note: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet, and begged him to come…
Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.
When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him,
When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him, and begged him that he would come down and…
I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus,

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
translations.bsb: When the centurion heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish elders to ask Him to come and heal his servant.
translations.kjv: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
translations.asv: And when he heard concerning Jesus, he sent unto him elders of the Jews, asking him that he would come and save his servant.
